scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: A reporter from the local paper called this morning.
scene.zh: 地方報社的記者今天早上打來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: His name is Ryan Cole, and he wants to interview you about Lantern.
scene.zh: 他叫 Ryan Cole，想訪問你，聊 Lantern。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Why does he want to interview me instead of Mr. Ellis?
scene.zh: 他為什麼想訪問我，而不是訪問 Mr. Ellis？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: His editor wants a story on the product. You know it best.
scene.zh: 他的編輯想要一篇講產品的報導。你最了解它了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's not a national paper, but half the neighborhood reads it.
scene.zh: 那不是全國性的報紙，不過這一帶有一半的人都在看。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's good publicity, and it's your first time speaking in public for the company.
scene.zh: 這是很好的宣傳，也是你第一次代表公司公開發言。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've never talked to a reporter, so any tips would help.
scene.zh: 我從來沒跟記者打過交道，有什麼建議都很有幫助。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Don't worry. We'll prepare together tomorrow.
scene.zh: 別擔心。我們明天一起準備。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They'll publish it on Saturday, and part of it may be on the radio.
scene.zh: 他們星期六會刊出來，有一部分說不定還會上廣播。

fills.en: Should I ___ my answers, or is that a bad idea?
fills.zh: 我要把答案背下來嗎？還是這樣反而不好？

fills.en: If I ___ more time, I'd practice every answer twice.
fills.zh: 如果我有更多時間，每個回答我都會練兩次。
fills.note: If 後面用過去式，後半句用 I'd。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: With the media, you're our spokesperson now. Let's get you ready.
scene.zh: 面對媒體，你現在就是我們的發言人。我們來幫你準備吧。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I memorize my answers, or is that a bad idea?
scene.zh: 我要把答案背下來嗎？還是這樣反而不好？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Don't memorize every word. Answers like that always sound generic.
scene.zh: 別每個字都背。那樣的回答聽起來總是很制式。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Just know what you want to convey, and say it in your own words.
scene.zh: 只要清楚你想傳達什麼，再用自己的話說出來就好。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's agree on the three points I need to get across.
scene.zh: 我們先講好我一定要講清楚的三個重點吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Our design, the factory in Taiwan, and the lamps for the schools.
scene.zh: 好。我們的設計、台灣的工廠，還有送給學校的燈。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Say them more than once. A little repetition helps ordinary readers remember.
scene.zh: 多講幾次。重複一點，一般讀者比較記得住。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And one word of caution: keep everything factual.
scene.zh: 還要提醒你一件事：每句話都要有事實根據。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If he asks about a rumor, don't guess. Our reputation matters more.
scene.zh: 如果他問到什麼傳言，不要用猜的。公司的名聲比較重要。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, I'm the reporter now. So, why should a store sell Lantern?
scene.zh: 好，現在我是記者。那麼，店家為什麼要賣 Lantern？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What makes Lantern different is that it's designed by us and made in Taiwan.
scene.zh: Lantern 最不一樣的地方，是我們自己設計、在台灣製造。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice. Stores like that it's authentic, not a cheap copy.
scene.zh: 不錯。店家就是喜歡它是真材實料，不是便宜的仿冒品。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Next question. Are the lamps environmentally friendly?
scene.zh: 下一題。這些燈環保嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What our customers love is how little energy the lamps use.
scene.zh: 客人最喜歡的，是這些燈非常省電。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great answer. Less energy means less pollution, so say that, too.
scene.zh: 答得好。用電少就代表污染少，這點也要說。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He might also ask if they conform to US safety standards.
scene.zh: 他可能還會問，這些燈有沒有符合美國的安全標準。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And every product has a drawback. Be ready to talk about the price.
scene.zh: 而且每個產品都有缺點。要準備好談價格的問題。

passages.title: Your interview for the Saturday edition
lines: Thank you for agreeing to talk to me. I'm writing a piece for our "Local Business" page in the Saturday edition on October 22. It is published online on the same day, and most of our readers live in the neighborhood.
A short version will also be part of our radio broadcast, "City Talk." Your episode is planned for Thursday, October 20.

Could we meet on Thursday, October 13, at 2:00 p.m. in your conference room? The approximate length is 45 minutes. Later, at a different time, I'd like you to come to our studio and record a short version of about ten minutes for the radio.

I'll start with an introductory question about your job. Then I'll ask about the Lantern series and the company's work in the neighborhood. I've compiled a list of questions and attached it to this email. If you don't see the attachment, please check your spam folder. Don't worry, the list isn't excessive: there are only twelve questions.
Many of our readers care about the climate, so I may also ask how stores dispose of old lamps.
If Thursday doesn't work for you, please suggest an alternate time. Whoever would like to join you is welcome, too.
Harbor Trading has become one of the most influential small businesses in town, so our readers are curious. If you have any queries, call me at the paper.

questions.en: When will the radio episode be on?
questions.zh: 廣播那一集哪一天播出？

questions.en: What should you do if you can't find the list of questions?
questions.zh: 如果找不到問題清單，應該怎麼做？

questions.en: About how long will the interview on Thursday take?
questions.zh: 星期四的訪問大約多久？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I hear the reporter wrote to you. Can I see?
scene.zh: 聽說記者寫信給你了。我可以看看嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thursday at two, in our conference room? That works for me.
scene.zh: 星期四兩點，在我們的會議室？我可以。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He says the time is only approximate, so keep the whole afternoon free.
scene.zh: 他說時間只是大概，所以那天下午整個空下來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And his list of questions went to your spam folder? Funny.
scene.zh: 他的問題清單跑到你的垃圾郵件匣了？真好笑。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Later he wants to record a short version in their studio. Very nice.
scene.zh: 之後他還想在他們的錄音室錄一個短版。很不錯。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll write back and tell him Thursday afternoon works for us.
scene.zh: 我回信跟他說，我們星期四下午可以。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. I'll come, too. He says whoever wants to join is welcome.
scene.zh: 謝謝。我也會去。他說誰想一起來都歡迎。

lines.en: I'm recording on my tablet, okay? Ms. Carter, how did Harbor Trading begin?
lines.zh: 我用平板錄音，可以吧？Carter 女士，Harbor Trading 是怎麼開始的？

lines.en: We started 21 years ago, in a historic building by the harbor.
lines.zh: 二十一年前，在港口邊一棟老建築裡開始的。

lines.en: And desk lamps were always your specialty?
lines.zh: 桌燈一直都是你們的招牌產品嗎？

lines.en: Always. And Lantern is reasonably priced, so ordinary stores can sell it.
lines.zh: 一直都是。而且 Lantern 價格合理，一般的店家也能賣。

lines.en: Now, the donation. How did the lamps get to the schools?
lines.zh: 接下來談捐贈。這些燈是怎麼送到學校的？

lines.en: We worked with a local charity. They took them to the schools and a youth center.
lines.zh: 我們和本地的一個慈善機構合作，由他們送到學校和一間青少年中心。

lines.en: And how did the kids react?
lines.zh: 那孩子們的反應怎麼樣？

lines.en: They thanked us very enthusiastically. Some even wrote us letters.
lines.zh: 他們很熱情地跟我們道謝，有些還寫信給我們。

lines.en: That's amazing.
lines.zh: 太了不起了。

lines.en: It was really worthwhile for all of us.
lines.zh: 這件事對我們大家來說真的很值得。

questions.en: How long ago did Harbor Trading start?
questions.zh: Harbor Trading 是多久以前創立的？

questions.en: Who took the lamps to the schools?
What is Ryan using to record the interview?
questions.zh: Ryan 用什麼錄下這次訪問？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks for having me. I'll record this on my tablet, if that's okay.
scene.zh: 謝謝你們邀我來。我會用平板錄音，可以嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. Welcome to Harbor Trading. We founded it just down the street.
scene.zh: 當然。歡迎來到 Harbor Trading。我們當初就是在這條街過去一點的地方創立的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, tell me how the Lantern series began.
scene.zh: 那麼，跟我說說 Lantern 系列是怎麼開始的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We started Lantern because stores kept asking us for better design.
scene.zh: 我們會做 Lantern，是因為店家一直跟我們說想要設計更好的燈。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And I hear the company does a lot for the neighborhood.
scene.zh: 我還聽說你們公司為這一帶做了很多事。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This year we gave two hundred lamps to local schools.
scene.zh: 我們今年送了兩百盞燈給附近的學校。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's amazing. How did the kids like them?
scene.zh: 太了不起了。孩子們喜歡嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They loved them. One school sent us a big card from every class.
scene.zh: 他們很喜歡。有一間學校每一班都寄了一張大卡片給我們。

textFills.title: The interview
lines: The interview went well. The reporter asked about the ___ online, and we said there will be no layoffs.
Some critics online ask about it repeatedly, but this is not a crisis.
As I ___ you on Monday, we are hiring two more people this year.
The reporter may call some of you, too. ___
zh: 採訪很順利。記者問到網路上的傳言，我們說公司不會裁員。
網路上有些批評的人一直在問這件事，不過這不是什麼危機。
就像我星期一跟大家說的，我們今年還要再請兩個人。
記者可能也會打給你們其中幾位。請不要跟他說我們的銷售數字。

blanks.note: 網路上說要裁員的是傳言：rumor。
說的是星期一的事，用過去式 told。

options: Please don't share our sales numbers with him.
Please memorize his phone number for him.
Please ask him to stop calling the paper.
Please send him to the youth center.
blanks.note: 記者打來時，提醒大家不要透露數字。

prompt.en: Is it true you're cutting jobs?

responses.en: Yes, I cut it this morning.

prompt.en: Can you reveal your sales numbers?
prompt.zh: 你可以透露你們的銷售數字嗎？

responses.zh: 我昨天數過那些數字了。

prompt.en: Did the reporter get everything he needed?
prompt.zh: 記者要的東西都拿到了嗎？

responses.en: He's a reporter for the paper.
Yes, he said he had enough.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now a more controversial question. There's a rumor online about layoffs here.
scene.zh: 接下來是比較有爭議的問題。網路上有傳言說你們要裁員。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So I have to ask. Is it true you're cutting jobs?
scene.zh: 所以我一定要問。你們真的要裁員嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: As I told our team, we're actually hiring this year.
scene.zh: 就像我跟團隊說過的，我們今年其實還在徵人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And officially, there are no plans for layoffs. You can quote me on that.
scene.zh: 而且正式來說，公司沒有任何裁員計畫。這句你可以直接引用。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That should reassure a lot of people. So, how much has Lantern sold?
scene.zh: 這應該能讓很多人放心。那麼，Lantern 賣了多少？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: As I mentioned earlier, I can't share our exact sales numbers.
scene.zh: 我剛才也提過，確切的銷售數字我沒辦法透露。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fair enough. Last one: there are illegal copies of Lantern online. Are they a threat?
scene.zh: 好吧。最後一題：網路上有 Lantern 的非法仿冒品。那對你們是威脅嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not really. Stores want the real thing, and so do their customers.
scene.zh: 其實還好。店家要的是真品，他們的客人也是。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. That's the truth people want to hear. Thank you both.
scene.zh: 很好。這就是大家想聽的實話。謝謝兩位。

lines.en: This is Ryan Cole with the City Talk business bulletin.
lines.zh: 這裡是 Ryan Cole，為您帶來 City Talk 的商業快報。

lines.en: A few years ago, several small lamp stores in town went into bankruptcy.
lines.zh: 幾年前，鎮上好幾家小燈具店破產了。

lines.en: But one local company, Harbor Trading, has become a prominent name.
lines.zh: 但有一家本地公司 Harbor Trading 卻成了知名的公司。

lines.en: Since its Lantern series came out in May, sales have soared.
lines.zh: 它的 Lantern 系列五月上市後，銷售量一路飆升。

lines.en: When material costs went up, the company absorbed the cost instead of raising prices.
lines.zh: 材料成本上漲時，公司自己吸收了成本，沒有漲價。

lines.en: It also streamlined the way it takes orders from stores.
lines.zh: 它也簡化了接店家訂單的流程。

lines.en: Lantern lamps use much less energy than older models, so they produce less carbon.
lines.zh: Lantern 的燈比舊型的省電很多，產生的碳也比較少。

lines.en: With more awareness of the climate, that matters to buyers.
lines.zh: 大家愈來愈注意氣候問題，這一點對買家很重要。

lines.en: Store owners tell me the popularity of the lamps comes from their reliability.
lines.zh: 店家老闆跟我說，這些燈受歡迎是因為它們很耐用。

lines.en: Many offices have insufficient light, and more stores now opt for desk lamps with good design.
lines.zh: 很多辦公室的照明不足，現在也有愈來愈多店家選擇設計好的桌燈。

lines.en: Can the company sustain this growth? We will see. For now, the exposure is good for business.
lines.zh: 這家公司能不能維持這樣的成長？我們拭目以待。至少目前，這些曝光對生意很有幫助。

lines.en: For the remainder of the show, we'll take your calls.
lines.zh: 節目接下來的時間，我們開放聽眾來電。

questions.en: What did the company do when costs went up?
questions.zh: 成本上漲時，公司怎麼做？

questions.en: How are Lantern lamps better than older models?
questions.zh: Lantern 的燈比舊型的好在哪裡？

questions.en: What will the show do next?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Quick, turn up the radio! The reporter's show is on.
scene.zh: 快，把收音機開大聲！那個記者的節目開始了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Listen, there you are! That was your voice. You sounded great.
scene.zh: 你聽，是你耶！那是你的聲音。你聽起來很棒。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I can't believe they played my whole answer on the radio.
scene.zh: 真不敢相信他們在廣播裡把我的回答整段播出來了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And he called us a prominent company. Not bad at all!
scene.zh: 而且他說我們是知名的公司。真不賴！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sales have soared, he said. Ms. Carter is going to love that.
scene.zh: 他說銷售飆升。Carter 女士一定會很愛聽這句。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This kind of exposure is great for Lantern.
scene.zh: 這種曝光對 Lantern 很有幫助。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now we just have to sustain it, right?
scene.zh: 現在我們只要把它維持下去就好了，對吧？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Look at that headline! And he even got the part about layoffs right.
scene.zh: 你看那個標題！而且連裁員那部分他都寫對了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm glad he quoted me correctly on the hard question.
scene.zh: 還好那個難回答的問題，他引用我的話沒寫錯。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This article really validates the work you put into Lantern.
scene.zh: 這篇報導真的證明你在 Lantern 上下的功夫是對的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Two store purchasers have already called about it.
scene.zh: 已經有兩家店的採購打來問了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll circulate it and keep a few copies handy.
scene.zh: 我會把它傳給大家看，再留幾份放在手邊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, now that it's over, how do you feel?
scene.zh: 那麼，現在都結束了，你覺得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: If I did it again, I'd keep my answers even shorter.
scene.zh: 如果再來一次，我會把回答講得更簡短。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good news. A reporter from the city radio station called. He wants an interview, too.
scene.zh: 好消息。市裡的電台有記者打來，他也想採訪。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And he asked for you by name.
scene.zh: 而且他指名要找你。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Why does he want to interview me instead of Mr. Ellis?
scene.zh: 他為什麼想訪問我，而不是訪問 Mr. Ellis？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He heard your answer on Ryan's show and liked it.
scene.zh: 他在 Ryan 的節目上聽到你的回答，很喜歡。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I can't believe they played my whole answer on the radio.
scene.zh: 真不敢相信他們在廣播裡把我的回答整段播出來了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well, it was a good answer. And Ryan's article helped, too.
scene.zh: 嗯，那個回答很好。Ryan 的報導也有幫助。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm glad he quoted me correctly on the hard question.
scene.zh: 還好那個難回答的問題，他引用我的話沒寫錯。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He did. So, can you do the same time as last time, Thursday at two?
scene.zh: 確實。那你可以跟上次一樣，星期四兩點嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll write back and tell him Thursday afternoon works for us.
scene.zh: 我回信跟他說，我們星期四下午可以。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Any adjustments you want to make this time?
scene.zh: 很好。這次有什麼想調整的地方嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: If I did it again, I'd keep my answers even shorter.
scene.zh: 如果再來一次，我會把回答講得更簡短。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. I'd urge you to do that. Now, let's prepare like last time.
scene.zh: 很好，我也很建議你這樣做。那我們就跟上次一樣準備吧。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's agree on the three points I need to get across.
scene.zh: 我們先講好我一定要講清楚的三個重點吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Same three as before. Can you play the reporter again, Dan?
scene.zh: 跟上次一樣那三個。Dan，你可以再扮一次記者嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. First question: why did you start Lantern?
scene.zh: 沒問題。第一題：你們為什麼會做 Lantern？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We started Lantern because stores kept asking us for better design.
scene.zh: 我們會做 Lantern，是因為店家一直跟我們說想要設計更好的燈。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And what makes it special?
scene.zh: 那它有什麼特別的地方？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What makes Lantern different is that it's designed by us and made in Taiwan.
scene.zh: Lantern 最不一樣的地方，是我們自己設計、在台灣製造。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Some critics say you're cutting jobs. Is that true?
scene.zh: 有些批評的人說你們要裁員。是真的嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: As I told our team, we're actually hiring this year.
scene.zh: 就像我跟團隊說過的，我們今年其實還在徵人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Perfect. You're more than ready.
scene.zh: 太好了。你已經準備得非常充分了。
